descripcion_geo: Northern town mentioned alongside Meshech and Gog; identified with Anatolian or Caucasus populations.
importancia_estrategica: Northern people in the eschatological oracles of Ezekiel.

historias.titulo: Tubal in the table of nations
historias.descripcion: Tubal is the son of Japheth along with Meshech; They represent people from the north of the known biblical world.
Ezekiel describes how Tubal and Meshech traded slaves and bronze vessels with Tyre.
Gog is prince of Meshech and Tubal in the eschatological prophecy of Ezekiel.

personajes.descripcion: He mentioned Tubal as part of Gog's eschatological army.
Father of Tubal in the table of nations; progenitor of the northern peoples.
He prophesied that in the last days God will send messengers to Tubal to announce his glory.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Tubal: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The towns of the extreme north

judaismo.descripcion: Tubal and Meshech represent the northern limits of the known world; in the eschatological oracles, they attack Israel but are destroyed by God.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Tubal and Meshech represent the northern limits of the known world; in the eschatological oracles, they attack Israel but are destroyed by God.
